description: Multiplies or divides a phase ramp by a whole number, in three units of panel width.

params.text: Sets the whole-number factor, -199 to 199; positive numbers run the output faster and negative numbers slower, and the display shows the number with a sign for which.

inputs.text: Scales the factor by a factor of two for every volt, and the result is rounded back to a whole number or to one over a whole number.
The phase ramp to multiply or divide, 0-10V per cycle.
A trigger here sends the output phase back to 0.

outputs.text: A square held high through the first half of each output cycle, or a 1ms 10V trigger at the start of it when Gate Mode is turned off.
The multiplied or divided phase ramp, 0V to 10V per cycle.

notes: Nothing moves until a phase ramp is patched to the PHASE input.
This module hands its own phase to a Divider, Div or Div (Expander) touching either side of it, with no cable, but it never takes a phase from a neighbour itself.
menu: Gate Mode — holds the CLK output high through the first half of each output cycle instead of firing a 1ms trigger at the start of it; this module comes up with it on

inputs.0:
bipolar · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the knob setting alone.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads no phase, and no output movement.
inputs.2:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads no reset; a negative voltage does nothing here.
